ruleset.name: expert_framework
ruleset.description: Initial set of expert privacy rules derived from GDPR and NIST.
rules: If data is collected from minors, strict consent is required.
If location data is stored, it must be encrypted at rest.
If personal data is shared with third parties, a data processing agreement must be in place.
If automated decision-making is used, the user must have the right to opt-out.
If a data breach occurs, affected users must be notified within 72 hours.
